Observation 1: The machine runs one large mixture of experts language model using system RAM and two graphics cards. Most expert weights live in system RAM because they do not all fit in graphics memory. Every generated token selects a small subset of experts in every layer. The processor evaluates experts that are not resident on a graphics card. An expert cache can reduce processor work but requires copies, synchronization, and careful buffer lifetimes. Prompt processing can batch many tokens together, while single token generation has little work per operation.
